scope: All ARC-COMMUNITY and ARC-RECOVERY stories (127), plus every story in any arc naming recurring residents CHR-040 to CHR-049 (Elizondo, Nguyen, Hargrove, Cortez, Bell, Ramos, Fontenot, Dupree, Ortega, Whitfield), plus first-person columns by Treviño, Whitlock, Navarro and Benavides. Read in day order against 01_characters/canon.json, public_record.json and real Coastal Bend geography.
